data.body: New evidence (2026-08-05, session 6c3e-67c6-eafa-45e7): three review-plan runs launched CONCURRENTLY (~18:40 UTC, tickets 70bc-ab05-6d4c-45a0 / e1b1-859e-a7b4-48f2 / fd84-92b4-01ba-4911, all bedrock us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6) ALL failed byte-identically at step review@then/prerequisite_verify: status 400 ValidationException 'The model returned the following errors: Grammar compilation timed out'. 3-for-3 within minutes, three different plan texts, zero blocking findings in each — every finding degraded to no-verification and all three verdicts landed INDETERMINATE/unsigned. Two implications: (1) reproducibility is far higher than 'two runs minutes apart' — under concurrent load it was 100% here; (2) suspicion: CONCURRENCY correlates — pydantic-ai retried each ('Exceeded maximum output retries (2)' wraps the 400), so 3 parallel sessions were each compiling the same large structured-output grammar on Bedrock simultaneously. Next probe from this session: identical re-run SERIALLY (one review at a time) — if serial runs pass where concurrent ones 400d, that pins load/concurrency as the trigger; will report the result here.
